Inside Mac OS X: Aqua Human Interface Guidelines, Apple Computer, Inc., October 2001, which postdates 10.0.x

window_frame.note: Finder and Copy preserve the small rounded frame, pinstriped fill, resize ridges, and pronounced hard-bottomed shadow.

title_bar.note: Finder preserves Cheetah's pale 22px pinstripe title band and centered Lucida Grande title.

window_buttons.note: Finder preserves the 13px glass traffic lights, 17px optical shadow envelope, 22px centre spacing, inactive form, and hover-only-glyph anatomy; the production component is held to the native 1x crop by the verified reproduction tolerance.

toolbar.note: Finder preserves the strongly striped toolbar, segmented view control, separator rule, and large icon commands.

buttons.note: The Copy window preserves a compact pill-shaped Stop button beside the progress track.

choice_controls.note: General Preferences preserves silver Aqua pop-ups with a saturated blue paired-arrow segment and native radio states.

fields.note: TextEdit Open preserves inset location/value fields and their exact relationship to Aqua pop-up segments.

menus.note: The Apple Menu preserves pinstriped rows, blue selection, rules, disabled text, arrows, shortcuts, and hard lower shadow.

popovers.note: Apple's preliminary Aqua HIG, footered as a Macworld draft on 01/10/01 and copyright 2000, states that Help Tags replace Balloon Help as Mac OS X's answer to what's-that questions, so the surface existed in the 10.0 timeframe; its Help Tag Examples section carries no figure. The only Apple figure found, Figure 13-1, is in the October 2001 HIG, which postdates every 10.0.x release, so its crops are kept as the nearest evidence and must not be measured as 10.0 geometry. No 10.0.x screenshot showing a help tag has been found.

scrollbars.note: TextEdit Open preserves the first Aqua scroller's saturated ribbed blue gel thumb and bookended line buttons. The native horizontal resting state is verified below; vertical and pressed-state evidence is still required before the whole component family can be called verified.

lists_tables.note: Finder preserves icon-grid spacing, toolbar/client boundary, labels, and selection-free row geometry.

progress.note: Finder Copy preserves the striped progress capsule, its inset track, label stack, and adjacent Stop button.

alerts_toasts.note: Finder's native Empty Trash alert preserves the pinstriped rounded sheet, large Finder icon, bold question, secondary line, gray Cancel pill, and blue default OK pill.

typography.note: Finder, General Preferences, menu, and Copy preserve Lucida Grande at original 1x.

icons.note: Finder preserves early Aqua toolbar, home-folder, content, disk, and Dock artwork at period scale.

tolerance.method: Full-crop native-1x RGB RMSE after exact 64×20 size validation, plus native-pixel review of the 13px rim, 17px shadow envelope, 22px centre spacing, and glyphless resting state.

reproductions.note: Production WindowTitleBandView rendered at the crop's native 64×20 pixels in the resting, non-hover state. The three Cheetah gems intentionally carry no glyphs until hovered; their measured glass centreline, saturated side walls, two-stage neutral shadow, compact spacing, and four-row pinstripe phase are verified against Finder at 1x.

tolerance.method: Full-crop native-1x RGB RMSE after exact 633×16 size validation, plus native-pixel review of the two 17×16 end caps, asymmetric trough scanlines, periodic gel ribs, rounded thumb ends, and opaque output. The preserved screenshot contains a faint yellow trough artifact that production intentionally does not reproduce.

reproductions.note: Production ThemedScroller rendered against the tight 633×16 control extraction with the same horizontal axis, 16px trough, long recolorable gel thumb, and distinct measured bookends. The left end cap is pixel-identical; the right differs only in a few source color-fringe pixels. The wider crop remains above as frame and resize-corner context.
